clearance.title: Setifikeiti sa Bohlweki ba Sepolesa
clearance.applyTitle: Kopa Setifikeiti sa Bohlweki ba Sepolesa
clearance.applyIntro: Setifikeiti sa Bohlweki ba Sepolesa se netefatsa hore na ho na le rekoto kgahlanong le lebitso la hao, bakeng sa mohiri, sekolo, kapa ba boemedi ba bojaki.
clearance.officerNotes: Dintlha tsa ka hare (ha di hatiswe setifikeiting)
clearance.certifyIntro: Sena ke ho netefatsa hore patlisiso ya direkoto tsa sepolesa e entswe malebana le motho ya bitsitsweng ka tlase, ka sephetho se latelang:
clearance.resultStatementClean: Ha ho rekoto ya nyeoe e emeng ya bosholu e fumanweng kgahlanong le motho enwa ho fihlela letsatsing la ho ntshuwa.
clearance.resultStatementFound: Ho fumanwe rekoto kgahlanong le motho enwa. Ka kopo ikopanye le ofisi e ntshitseng bakeng sa dintlha tse ding.

admin.officesFormRequired: Lefapha, setereke le lebitso la lefapha la mosebetsi lia hlokahala.

admin.noOfficesYet: Ha ho na mafapha a mosebetsi a thehilweng ho fihlela hona jwale. Sebedisa foromo e kaholimo ho bula la pele.

appointments.title: Dikopano
appointments.applyIntro: Sebedisa sena haeba tshebeletso e hloka hore o tle ka botjhabela — bakeng sa ho ngolisa boitsebiso, ho nka diphetho tsa mmele (biometrics), ho nka tokomane, kapa netefatso ya botjhabela. Haeba o batla mofetoledi wa puo ya matsoho kapa thuso e nngwe e lokisitsweng pele ho nako ya hao, o ka e kenya ka tlase; ke boikgethelo mme e fumaneha ho mang kapa mang.
appointments.purposeHelp: Kgetha lebaka le loketseng boeti bona.
appointments.needsInterpreterLabel: Ke batla mofetoledi wa puo ya matsoho a lokisetswa boeti bona
appointments.needsInterpreterHelp: Ofisi e tla lokisa sena pele ho nako ya hao, e seng ha o fihla.
appointments.interpreterLanguageHelp: Mohlala, Puo ya Matsoho ya Lesotho.
appointments.interpreterLanguagePlaceholder: mohlala: Puo ya Matsoho ya Lesotho
appointments.accommodationNotes: Ho hong seo re lokelang ho se lokisa pele ho nako ya hao (boikgethelo)
appointments.accommodationNotesHelp: Mohlala, motho ya tla nao, kapa kamore e fatshe.
